data.desc: Palladyne AI is a U.S.-based technology company providing intelligent autonomy software and mission-critical components to the defense and advanced manufacturing sectors. Its patented collaborative autonomy technology enables drones, robots and other autonomous systems to work together in complex, high-risk environments, from the battlefield to the factory floor. The Company's solutions are developed and operated in America and built to meet the stringent security and compliance requirements of government and industrial customers.
